reply_text:
Reading mfuton's own progress ledgers. Before the outage the Lisp port was paused (10-04) and the effort moved to the Python side. Now checking what the Python lanes achieved in their last two days:The overnight progress harness lived in `/tmp/pyreg`, and `/tmp` wasn't restored. Checking the evidence store for claude-4's reports instead:There's a progress page that claude-4 set up on 10-04, and the `/tmp/pyreg` notes were copied to `~/mfuton-notes` before the outage. Reading both:The page has the answer. Pulling the correct-row counts over time from its chart data:㊥ (gist) Yes, it had started to move, and then it stalled. claude-4's progress page (https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/wip/mfuton-progress.html) tracks 110 curriculum rows. A row counts as correct only when it compiles and matches native Lean on fixed, preregistered expectations. The count went from **2 correct on 10-04 morning to 20 by that evening, then 21 on 10-05 at 10:46**. It stayed at 21 until the drive failed on 10-06. So 89 of 110 rows are still not correct.

🈖 (what the rise was made of) Most of the 10-04 jump came from *checking* rows that already worked, not from new fixes. The "lean-prereg" sweeps tested untested rows: "11 untested rows checked" alone took the count from 10 to 17. Only a few rows were closed by actual fixes: `bool-export-alias`, `field-not-call`, and `epsilonInfo`, which was the one row closed on 10-05.

㊢ (where it was stuck) The page counts each failing row under the first problem its latest test run hits; it calls these shared "stops". From 10-04 evening onward, 44–50 rows were waiting at the `term[_]` quotation stop. That was flat through 10-05. Merges on 10-05 got 8 rows past one stop (`psw/quotC`), but their next stop is `withRef Monad ?m`, so none of them became correct. In flight when the drive died:
- `psw/withref` (codex-30): approved in review, a cold check of 4 rows was running.
- `psw/atend3` (codex-19): the atEnd row's elaboration now matches Lean, and the code-generation step was being fixed.
- `psw/levels` (codex-32): universe levels, in discovery.

Commit activity was heavy: about 520 commits from 10-04 to 10-06, mostly from codex-19, 18, 23 and 17 and from claude-4.

㊟ (two caveats)
- **The Lisp side is paused on purpose.** You paused it on 10-04 to speed up the Python iteration. Its ledger says not to resume until you say so.
- **The page and its scripts are partly gone.** The page is frozen at 10-06 09:33, and whatever refreshed it every 15 minutes isn't running now. Its scripts lived in `/tmp/pyreg`, which wasn't restored. claude-4 had copied the notes to `~/mfuton-notes/pyreg` on 10-03, but anything added to `/tmp/pyreg` after that is only on the old disk (`/dev/sda`, still attached). All the mfuton branches are safe: I pushed them to your fork earlier tonight.

🈸 (before jumping in) Before hostplane removes `/dev/sda`, should I mount it read-only and copy out the old `/tmp/pyreg` and `/tmp/mfs-*` worktrees? That would recover the post-10-03 notes, the progress tooling and any uncommitted lane work, and get the page refreshing again.
